target.title: fix(poll): make the poll question visible both directions (echo out, backfill in)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Native iMessage poll balloons have **no title** — `item.title` is empty and Messages never renders it. The question you see on a native poll lives in a **separate caption message** whose `reply_to` is the poll guid (the composer's "comment or Send" field). imsg ignored this on both sides:

- **Outbound:** `poll send --question 'X'` stored `X` in the invisible `item.title`, so agent-created polls rendered as bare options with no question.
- **Inbound:** a native poll decoded from `chat.db` had `question=nil`, so agents saw a title-less `Poll — options: …`.

Confirmed against a natively-composed poll: `item.title` is empty; the question is the reply-to-the-poll caption.

## Why This Change Was Made

Make the poll question visible in both directions, matching native behavior, with no consumer changes required (OpenClaw already renders `📊 Poll: <question>` when the field is present, and passes `--question` on send).

## User Impact

- **Outbound** — `poll send` / `poll.send` RPC now send `--question` as a **plain caption message** right after the poll (no `reply_to`, so **no thread metadata** → clean caption, not a threaded-reply connector; matches the native render). `--comment` overrides. Agents keep passing only `--question`.
- **Inbound** — `enrichedPollEvent` **backfills** an empty created-poll question from its caption (earliest reply-to-the-poll message), so inbound native polls surface their question. imsg-created polls with a real title are unchanged; vote enrichment untouched.

## Evidence

**Outbound** — poll now gets a plain caption child, `thread_originator = None` (clean render), vs the old threaded reply:
```
POLL      guid=A3DDC24F…
comment   guid=C615FCEF…  reply_to=None  thread_originator=None   ← clean caption
```

**Inbound** — `imsg history --chat-id 3` (chat.db read, no bridge), native polls that were `question=None`:
```
2E97B312  question='Favorite crustacean friend of a Lobster?'  (was None)
AC8A8E5B  question='What color pill?'                          (was None)
BC2A0358  question='Favorite Cut of meat?'                     (was None)
40CA2E28  question='What kind of proactive help…'  (imsg-created title, unchanged)
```

Full end-to-end live PROOF through the gateway RPC is pending an unrelated bridge-injection issue on the test host; the CLI/chat.db paths above are verified.
